title: Warn before releasing a purchase order that was already sent electronically
summary: A warning now appears when releasing a purchase order that was already electronically sent, preventing silent re-export of the same e-document with the same identifier that would later cause conflicts.
key_points: Adds a confirmation prompt when releasing a purchase order that already has a sent e-document
The first release and retries after a failed export stay silent
Prevents quiet re-export with the same cbc:ID, which later caused duplicate external document number errors for the receiver
Stopgap until Peppol OrderChange, which is not supported yet, is available
Internal change only: one local procedure, one label and one call in an existing subscriber
quote: Releasing an order that already has a sent e-document now asks first, so they can back out.
